macros.name: PSX_BIOS_TAILJUMP_LOAD
macros.operation: Transfer control to a BIOS entry loaded from a pointer slot, preserving the caller's return address and arguments
macros.rationale: EnablePAD and DisablePAD independently load their entry slots into $9 and execute lui/lw/nop/jr/nop. This is an ABI transfer, not an ordinary C call or a scalar allocation workaround. The local register binding is confined to the shared operation definition.
